song.title: Hate To Say I Told You So

guitar.notes: The Hives, being Swedish, are known for their association with Swedish-made Hagstrom guitars; reasonably documented within garage-rock revival scene.

tone.target: garage-punk crunchy rhythm with biting treble and loose edge
tone.profile: garage-punk crunchy rhythm with biting treble and loose edge
tone.summary: A punchy, raw punk rhythm tone achieved using a UK 45 or UK 50 amp model, paired with an OD pedal for grit, and kept dry with a classic cabinet simulation.
corrections: lean more garage than modern metal
